name: CPU Radix Sort for Face Centroids
definition: An out-of-place sorting algorithm used on the CPU to sort face centroids, achieving linear time complexity at the expense of auxiliary memory.
summary: CPU Radix Sort for Face Centroids is a linear-time algorithm that sorts floating-point face centroids on the CPU by converting them to integers and using LSD radix sort, chosen for its high throughput in dynamic volume rendering scenes.
